killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole never centres the main axis of a pane that scrolls
why: Restores the shape Developer Tools shipped before issue #642, the same clip as its About sibling. LATENT rather than reachable today: the pane's content is short (318 CSS px at 844 wide), so it took a 568x280 viewport to put the heading above the scroll origin (y = -19, now y = +35); none of the four viewports it was measured at -- 320x480, 568x320, 667x375, 844x390 -- clipped it, which is a sample of four rather than a sweep of every device. The entry exists because the pane is the one the developer shell grows registry-generated controls into, and a pane that grows into a clip nobody re-measures is exactly how About shipped the defect for as long as it did. Killed by the same sweep as its siblings, which asserts the centred set is EMPTY over a scroller list pinned by name.
